[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
[[Space:Company A, 38th Regiment, Virginia Infantry, United States Civil War | Company A Roster]]
{{US Civil War|side=CSA|enlisted=1864|mustered=|regiment name=38th Virginia Infantry|unit=38th Regiment, Virginia Infantry (Pittsylvania Regiment)}}

 Asa H. Glasgow was born in Pittsylvania, Virginia on November 17, 1820.
On December 21, 1846, he married Jane Caroline Gardner in Pittsylvania.
In 1850 the couple is shown in the census of Pittsylvania. no children noted.
In 1860 in Laurel Grove, Pittsylvania, the couple is shown with a daughter:
Asa H Glascoe 		M 	38 	Virginia
Jane C Glascoe 		F 	32 	Virginia
#Susan A Glascoe 		F 	9 	Virginia
also in home: Nancy H Lewis 		F 	10 	Virginia

 Asa fought with the CSA in the Civil War. He was in Company A of the 38th Virginia Infantry, enlisting in 1864. He may have been in another unit prior to that.

  Asa survived, and through the 1880 census of Dan River, Pittsylvania, no other children were noted. Apparently his mother was living with he and Jane in 1870:
Asa H Glasgow 		M 	49 	Virginia
Jane C Glasgow 		F 	42 	Virginia

Susan A Glasgow 		F 	72 	Virginia
Albert Jones 		M 	8 	Virginia


  Wife Jane Catherine passed away prior to 1892, as the 1900 census of Seneca, Campbell, Virginia shows Asa remarried to Lucy J unknown, and the record notes married about 1892.

Asa H. Glasgow passed away on December 25, 1903, likely in Seneca, but was buried in Pittsylvania, Virginia.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-62]] is assessed at 84% (probable). High Family Journal 2001 p.20 gives Asa’s family context, and Susan A.Glasgow72 lived with Asa in 1870. James’s 1818 Susannah High marriage and Pittsylvania locality favour the selected father, although no held Asa record names him directly.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read Asa’s 1846 marriage bond and original death record for parents.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XR3G-VPY Virginia marriage record, ASA GLASGO, JANE C. GARDNER (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XR3G-VPY)]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
